title: Stickers for Pretending You Have Your Life Together
tagline: Perfect for when you finally pay a bill on time or remember to water your plant before it dies. Stick these on your laptop to remind yourself that yes, you did indeed make a bed today. Bonus points if you use them to track your 'adulting streak'—because nothing says 'I'm a functional human' like a gold star next to 'didn't cry at work.'

title: D&D? More Like D&D’oh
tagline: Because nothing says 'epic fantasy' like rolling a d20 made of plastic and pretending it’s a dragon egg. Perfect for the Dungeon Master who’s tired of players questioning their rolls—now they can blame the dragon’s breath instead of their luck.

title: Robot That’s Also a Car (But Worse at Both)
tagline: Ever wish your RC car could transform into a robot that’s slightly less good at being a car? Now it can! Perfect for the kid who wants to play with a car but gets bored halfway through. Or the adult who’s tired of pretending to care about their child’s toy collection. Either way, it’s a win.

title: Grandpa's War Rig
tagline: When your off-grid cabin needs a vehicle that’s seen more action than your dating life, this 1951 Willys M38 Jeep is your ticket. Perfect for hauling firewood while pretending you’re on a covert mission. Just don’t expect Bluetooth—this thing still runs on hope and duct tape.

title: Stormy Skies, Indoor Edition
tagline: For the person who loves to live in a perpetual state of 'it might rain.' This lamp isn't just a light source—it's a weather report, a mood setter, and a conversation starter for your next 'Why is my living room a thunderstorm?' dinner party. Perfect for those who want to bring the drama of a summer storm to their studio apartment.

title: Nerd Timepiece for the Terminally Online
tagline: For when you're debugging at 3 AM and need to know if it's time for a fourth cup of coffee or just time to admit defeat. This watch tells time in binary, because why not? Perfect for the engineer who's already memorized their spouse's birthday in hexadecimal.

title: Medieval Office Warfare
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm ready for battle' like a sword-shaped tie clip. Perfect for when your coworker starts mansplaining spreadsheets and you need to subtly remind them who's boss. Also great for LARPing your way through a board meeting. Just don't blame us if HR gets involved.

title: Slingshot for People Who Can't Commit
tagline: Perfect for the indecisive hunter who can't decide whether to fire or not. Imagine you're at a backyard barbecue, and your neighbor's cat is eyeing your steak. You load the slingshot, aim, and then... hesitate. This trigger release lets you ponder your life choices mid-aim. Just don't blame us if the cat gets a free meal.

title: Pocket Monsters of Badge Obsession
tagline: Because your adult life wasn't already full of enough meaningless achievements, now you can relive the glory days of being a 10-year-old Pokémon trainer. Perfect for that one friend who still talks about how they 'would've been champion if only their Charmander didn't evolve into a Charmeleon with a bad attitude.'

title: Your Dog’s Face on a Toilet Seat
tagline: For when your landlord demands a security deposit back, but your heart demands a tribute to Fido’s eternal judgmental stare. This isn’t just art—it’s a conversation starter for when your in-laws ask why your bathroom looks like a pet cemetery. Perfect for the ‘I love my dog more than people’ crowd.

title: Nerds Who Brunch
tagline: For the D&D player who insists on 'roleplaying' at brunch. This hoodie lets you signal your allegiance to the Resistance while waiting in line for avocado toast. Perfect for those 'I just rolled a nat 20 on my coffee order' moments.

title: Feline Timekeepers
tagline: For the cat owner who’s convinced their pet is secretly a time lord. Each month features a new whiskered warlord, from 'January: The Nap Emperor' to 'December: The Treat Tyrant.' Perfect for marking the days until your next vet bill or that one time your cat brought you a 'gift.'

title: See-Through Icebox for Overthinkers
tagline: For the person who needs to confirm their beer is still cold without opening the lid. Perfect for tailgates where your friends won’t stop asking if you’ve got any left. Now you can just point at the empty void and say, 'Nope, but enjoy the existential dread of seeing your own reflection in a cooler.'

title: Lab Rat's Caffeine Delivery System
tagline: For the chemist who's too busy calculating molar masses to remember they're human. This mug is perfect for stirring your morning brew while pretending it's a beaker. Bonus points if you accidentally drink your coffee with a pipette. Just don't blame us if you start titrating your oat milk.

title: Honk If You Love Corgis
tagline: For the individual who finds themselves weeping uncontrollably at dog videos while stuck in traffic. Now you can dab your tears with a tissue pulled directly from a fluffy corgi posterior. Because what better way to process existential dread than with canine-themed paper products?

title: The Cleavage Camouflage
tagline: For those days when your neckline is too modest but your bra is too conspicuous. This scarf is the sartorial equivalent of a 'Do Not Disturb' sign—perfect for the office holiday party where your boss keeps asking about your 'personal growth.'

title: Frozen Food Freedom
tagline: Tired of waiting for your frozen waffles to thaw? This tray is the overachiever of kitchen gadgets, defrosting your food in minutes. Perfect for those mornings when you realize you forgot to take out the chicken for dinner... again. It's like having a tiny, non-judgmental sous chef who only cares about your food's temperature.

title: The Yacht for People Who Hate Yachts
tagline: Imagine you're at a 'yacht party' but it's actually just you and your cat, because you're allergic to both people and fun. This is the boat for you. It's like a tiny apartment that floats, perfect for those who want to be alone but still want to brag about having a yacht. Bonus: it's small enough to fit in your garage, so you can finally fulfill your dream of being a pirate in your own driveway.

title: Banshee Chic: Undead Elegance
tagline: For when your LARP group decides to raid Stormwind at 3 AM. This Sylvanas set is perfect for the undead enthusiast who wants to look menacing while waiting in line at the DMV. Complete with the haunted stare of someone who’s seen too many respawn timers.

title: Roller Derby Stealth Mode
tagline: For when you're cruising through the park and suddenly remember you're not supposed to be there. These wheel shields turn your skateboard into a silent ninja, perfect for sneaking past that one neighbor who always yells at you for 'making too much noise.' Bonus: they double as tiny shields for when you inevitably wipe out and need to protect your dignity from onlookers.

title: Alien Invasion? Nah, Just Your Legs
tagline: When you're too cool for plain black leggings but not cool enough for full-on cosplay, these are your middle ground. Perfect for that awkward moment at the grocery store when you realize you're wearing the same outfit as the guy who just abducted your neighbor's cat. Bonus: they double as a conversation starter at UFO conventions.

title: Glow Stick for Your iPhone
tagline: Ever find yourself fumbling in the dark, trying to plug in your phone like a drunkard at a bar? This cable lights up like a disco stick, so you can finally stop pretending you're a blindfolded contortionist. Perfect for those 'I dropped my phone in the club bathroom' emergencies.

title: Beasts of Burlesque
tagline: For when your New Year's Eve party needs to escalate from 'wild' to 'what even is humanity anymore.' These paper mache animal masks turn your living room into a safari of questionable decisions. Perfect for that friend who insists on reciting Shakespeare in character—this time as a hyena.

title: Pizza for the Pregnant
tagline: Because nothing says 'congratulations on your impending existential crisis' like a registry that lets Aunt Karen gift you a large pepperoni instead of a onesie. Perfect for the expecting parent who wants to ensure their child’s first memory is of their parents arguing over who ate the last slice.

title: Alpaca Squeeze Buddy
tagline: For when you need a hug, but human touch is overrated. This alpaca pillow is perfect for lonely Netflix nights or awkward family gatherings where eye contact is a no-go.

title: Flame On, But Safely
tagline: For the Pokémon trainer who wants to set the mood without summoning a real fire. Perfect for your 'I chose you' anniversary dinner—just don't let Pikachu near it. The candle wax might not be as effective as a Potion, but at least it won't run out of PP.

title: Rock Crawling Madness Ensues
tagline: For the friend who thinks hiking is boring, but watching RC cars climb rocks is thrilling. Spend hours building this kit, then immediately destroy it on a rocky terrain, because that's what friends are for.

title: Ice, Ice, Baby (Sword)
tagline: For when your LARPing crew insists on 'authentic' but you're more 'Winterfell garage sale' than 'Westeros royalty'. Perfect for fending off wildlings at your next Renaissance fair or convincing your cat you're a Targaryen. Just don't expect it to actually turn into ice—unless you're in a particularly well-air-conditioned dungeon.

title: Time to Swap Faces
tagline: For the chronically indecisive, these watches let you swap faces faster than you can say 'I regret my life choices.' Perfect for the boardroom meeting where you need to look like you have your act together, but also want to subtly signal to your coworkers that you'd rather be napping.

title: Overpriced Horror Diorama
tagline: Because your shelf needs a haunted hotel, this diorama is perfect for reenacting The Shining in your living room, much to your roommate's dismay.

title: Glow Up Your Failures
tagline: For when you're too cool to carry a flashlight but not cool enough to avoid potholes. This LED kit turns your skateboard into a disco on wheels, perfect for those nights when you're trying to impress your cat with your 'skills' while avoiding that one crack in the sidewalk that always gets you.

title: Han Solo’s Sugar Rush
tagline: When your Jedi Council meeting runs long and you need a snack that won’t get you force-choked, this chocolate Millennium Falcon is your hyperspace escape. Perfect for the Star Wars fan who’s also a ‘I’ll have the chocolate, hold the guilt’ kind of rebel. Just don’t try to outrun the sugar crash.

title: Sweat & Regret Starter Pack
tagline: For when your friend claims they can handle 'a little heat'—then spends the next hour alternating between chugging milk and Googling 'why does my face feel like lava?' This crate is your revenge. Includes everything from 'mildly uncomfortable' to 'call an ambulance' spice levels. Perfect for that office potluck where you want to be remembered as the one who brought the apocalypse in a box.

title: Screaming Your Way To Debt
tagline: Finally, a way to terrify the neighbors *and* simultaneously make them question your sanity. Imagine: You're cornered by a squirrel in your own backyard. Instead of running like a normal person, you unleash the unholy shriek of a thousand Aztec souls directly into its beady little eyes. Is it effective? Probably not. Will you feel ridiculous? Absolutely. But hey, at least you're broke *and* culturally insensitive.

title: Backpack or Fridge?
tagline: For the urban nomad who refuses to compromise between 'I need to carry my laptop' and 'I need to keep my artisanal kombucha at exactly 42°F.' This backpack cooler is the love child of a tech bag and a picnic basket, perfect for that one coworker who insists on bringing their own lunch—just in case the office fridge is a microbiology experiment.

title: Silent Disco for Your Brain
tagline: Ever been stuck on a bus next to someone blasting their favorite podcast? Now you can be that person, but in reverse. These earplugs let you enjoy your music in peace while everyone else assumes you're just ignoring them. Perfect for pretending to be asleep on a cross-country flight or faking a phone call to avoid small talk at a family reunion.

title: Floral Force Awakens
tagline: Because nothing says 'I love you' like a bouquet of plastic Star Wars characters. Perfect for that awkward first date where you both agree that 'The Phantom Menace' was actually underrated. Just don't expect them to wilt—these guys have been frozen in carbonite for decades.

title: Laptop Bag & Stand: The Multitasking Mule
tagline: For the digital nomad who refuses to choose between a bag and a stand, this hybrid is your overachieving sidekick. Picture this: You're in a café, balancing a latte in one hand and a croissant in the other, when suddenly your laptop decides to take a nap on your lap. This bag-turned-stand is like a loyal butler, ready to elevate your device at a moment's notice. Just don't ask it to fetch your coffee—it's already multitasking.

title: Bag Glow-Up
tagline: For when your purse is so deep it could swallow a small child, but you still can't find your keys. This little light clips onto your bag like a tiny nightlight for grown-ups who've given up on organization. Perfect for fumbling through your bottomless pit of receipts and lipsticks at 3 AM while pretending you're not a hoarder.

title: Tiny Mule Mugs for Tiny Problems
tagline: Because sometimes you need a Moscow Mule, but your adult-sized problems require a shot-sized solution. Perfect for that awkward moment when your date asks about your ex, or when your boss asks why the TPS reports are late. Comes in a set of four, because misery loves company—and so does vodka.

title: Tooth Tax Evasion
tagline: For the parent who's tired of playing financial roulette with the Tooth Fairy's inflationary rates. This necklace lets you skip the cash exchange entirely—just pop the tooth in the pendant and call it a 'souvenir.' Perfect for when your kid asks for a Tesla payment plan for their next molar.

title: Fly Swat Goals
tagline: For when you want to swat flies like a superhero, but really you're just trying to survive a picnic with your in-laws.

title: Cage's Face On My Coffee
tagline: For when you need Nicolas Cage's intense stare to judge you for drinking coffee at 3 PM on a Tuesday, this mug is perfect. It's like having a national treasure, but less valuable and more ceramic.

title: Apocalypse in a Box (Stormproof Matches)
tagline: For when your survivalist friend insists on a 'low-key' camping trip but the forecast calls for 'biblical.' These matches laugh in the face of monsoons, hurricanes, and that one guy who always forgets the lighter. Perfect for lighting a fire while debating the merits of canned beans vs. MREs in a rainstorm.

title: Sweatproof Pants for the Lazy
tagline: Perfect for those 'I just woke up but need to pretend I’m productive' mornings. These pants absorb sweat so you can skip the shower and still fool your coworkers into thinking you’re a functional adult. Ideal for marathon Zoom meetings where your camera is off, but your guilt is on full display.

title: Pet SOS: Your Dog’s Dating Profile
tagline: For when your dog’s ‘lost’ poster looks like a Tinder bio. These tags turn your pup into a walking emergency contact—because nothing says ‘I’m a responsible owner’ like a phone number dangling from a collar. Perfect for the moment your escape artist decides to audition for *Home Alone 3*.

title: Tower of Hydration
tagline: For the overachiever who needs to track their water intake by the square inch. Perfect for the office worker who wants to intimidate coworkers with a Jenga-like stack of hydration. Bonus: watch your boss panic when you accidentally knock over the entire tower during a Zoom call.

title: Choo Choo, Goes Your Savings!
tagline: Finally, a train set for the obscenely wealthy shut-in who peaked in model railroading at age 47. Imagine: You, in your silk pajamas, orchestrating a tiny, gilded apocalypse on a miniature track while muttering about the decline of Western civilization. Just remember, each meticulously crafted, historically accurate carriage costs more than your actual car. Enjoy bankruptcy!

title: Bricks to the Moon
tagline: For the astronaut wannabe who can't afford space camp, but can afford to build their own shuttle. Perfect for when your kid asks 'What did you do before TikTok?' and you need to prove you once had hobbies. Bonus: No risk of actual space debris.

title: Snow White’s Vinyl Reboot
tagline: Because nothing says 'timeless fairy tale' like a PVC dress that sticks to your thighs. Perfect for that underground rave where the DJ insists on playing Disney remixes, or when you need to channel your inner poisoned apple at a Halloween party. Just don’t expect the dwarves to help you zip it up.

title: Orc Your Friends
tagline: For when you need to intimidate your roommate into doing the dishes, or just want to spice up your weekly D&D nights with some genuine orc-ish terror.

title: Petals on a Chain
tagline: For the botanist who refuses to commit to a tattoo. This necklace lets you wear your love for flowers literally around your neck—until the petals inevitably fall off, leaving you with a sad stem pendant and a lesson in impermanence. Perfect for that first date where you want to subtly signal, 'I’m high-maintenance but also biodegradable.'
